name: Giving Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to persevere and not give up, assuring them that God is with them and strengthens them in times of difficulty. Joshua 1:9 commands courage and confidence because the Lord is always present, while Psalms 37:24 reminds us that even if we stumble, God upholds us. Jesus invites the weary to find rest in Him (Matthew 11:28) and affirms that with God all things are possible (Mark 10:27). Believers are called to remain diligent and fervent in their service (Romans 12:11) and to continue doing good without growing weary, trusting that in due time they will reap the rewards if they do not faint (Galatians 6:9).
